 Nov 09, 2026 at 05:45 PM Craig Peters Editing Director & Quality Control
 Copied! 
 MINNEAPOLIS — The Minnesota Vikings announced the following players will be inactive for their Week 9 game of 2026 against the Buffalo Bills.
 Quarterback Kyler Murray
 Safety Jakobe Thomas
 Wide receiver Jauan Jennings
 Cornerback Chuck Demmings
 Safety Theo Jackson
 Defensive lineman Caleb Banks
 Carson Wentz will start at quarterback and be backed up by Max Brosmer.
